**Idea:** Event — the big AI chatbot launch (launch-day euphoria vs. the tired aftermath). **A = triumphant founder**: wide grin, wide eyes, raised brows, tall tilted hat with an antenna. **B = the weary industry veteran months later**: heavy under-eye bags, frown, same head now read with a limp hat and sagging collar. Shared eyes; grin ↔ hat band, chin ↔ hat crown, bow tie ↔ pompom, nose ↔ brim.

Stage 1 — writing the skeleton.

Fix: end the hat fill at the band (y=320) so the band/brim lines stay on light ground in B, and delete the stray B-only arc.
